known_issues: Bug: 'No Data Available / No Nakshatras found' error indicates backend may need initialization

new_feature_requests.summary: Diagnose and fix the backend initialization issue preventing Nakshatra data from being available, ensuring all 27 Nakshatras are properly initialized with their complete data including name, description, deity, symbol, ruling planet, pada information, lunarClimate, and karmicLesson fields
Ensure the migration logic properly transforms any existing data and initializes missing Nakshatras if the backend storage is empty or incomplete
Add defensive error handling to gracefully handle and log initialization failures, providing clear feedback if data seeding or migration encounters issues
Modify backend/main.mo to check if Nakshatra storage is empty on initialization and automatically trigger migration seeding if no data exists
Add initialization logging to backend/main.mo to track when migration seeding occurs and report success or failure
Ensure migration.mo seeding logic is invoked during backend initialization when storage is empty, populating all 27 Nakshatras with their complete astronomical and mythological data

projectName: Fix backend initialization error causing 'No Nakshatras found'
